en.text: Arora and Gurmeet were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3 : 2. questions.answer: B: Arora withdrew at the beginning of each quarter starting Oct 1 (2 quarters: Oct 1 and Jan 1). Drawings = ₹ 30,000 × 2 = ₹ 60,000. Periods remaining: 6 months and 3 months; average period = (6 + 3)/2 = 4.5 months. Interest = 60,000 × 12% × 4.5/12 = ₹ 2,700.

en.text:
There are two statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R) :

Reason (R) : On admission, the new partner gets the right to acquire share in the assets and profits of the partnership firm.
Choose the correct option from the following :
options: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.
Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.

hi.text:
यहाँ दो कथन दिए गए हैं अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) :
अभिकथन (A) : एक साझेदारी फर्म में एक नए साझेदार के प्रवेश के समय, नया प्रविष्ट हुआ साझेदार एक सहमत राशि पूँजी के रूप में या नकद अथवा वस्तु के रूप में लाता है ।
कारण (R) : प्रवेश के समय नए साझेदार को साझेदारी फर्म की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा लाभों में भाग लेने का अधिकार प्राप्त होता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
options: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है ।
अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।
अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है ।

questions.answer: A: Capital is brought in exchange for acquiring rights in the firm's assets, so Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A).

en.text: Mansi and Uma were partners in a firm and their capitals were ₹ 4,00,000 and ₹ 2,00,000 respectively. Normal rate of return in a similar business was 15% and the goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 4,00,000. hi.text: मानसी तथा उमा एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं और उनकी पूँजी क्रमशः ₹ 4,00,000 तथा ₹ 2,00,000 थीं । इसी प्रकार के व्यवसाय में प्रत्याय की सामान्य दर 15% थी तथा फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्य ₹ 4,00,000 था । यदि ख्याति की गणना अधिलाभों के चार वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर की गई थी, तो फर्म के औसत लाभ थे :

questions.answer: D: Capital employed = 4,00,000 + 2,00,000 = ₹ 6,00,000. Normal profit = 6,00,000 × 15% = ₹ 90,000. Super profit = Goodwill / 4 = 4,00,000 / 4 = ₹ 1,00,000. Average profit = Normal profit + Super profit = 90,000 + 1,00,000 = ₹ 1,90,000.

On 1st April, 2025, they admitted Raghu as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm. On the date of Raghu's admission, it was found that the equipment is undervalued by ₹ 90,000. After revaluation, the Balance Sheet of Sujata, Laxmi and Raghu showed equipment at ₹ 3,00,000. The value of equipment shown in the books of the firm of Sujata and Laxmi before Raghu's admission was :

hi.text: सुजाता और लक्ष्मी एक फर्म की साझेदार थीं तथा 2 : 1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करती थीं । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 को उन्होंने फर्म के लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए रघु को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया । रघु के प्रवेश की तिथि पर संयंत्र को ₹ 90,000 से कम मूल्य का पाया गया । पुनर्मूल्यांकन के बाद सुजाता, लक्ष्मी तथा रघु का स्थिति विवरण संयंत्र को ₹ 3,00,000 पर दर्शा रहा था । रघु के प्रवेश से पूर्व सुजाता तथा लक्ष्मी की फर्म की पुस्तकों में दर्शाया गया संयंत्र का मूल्य था :

questions.answer: B: Revalued amount = ₹ 3,00,000 after increasing by ₹ 90,000. Old book value = 3,00,000 - 90,000 = ₹ 2,10,000.

en.text: On 1st April, 2024, DD Ltd. issued 2,000, 9% Debentures of ₹ 50 each at a premium of 5%, redeemable at a premium of ₹ 10 per debenture after five years. Interest on the debentures was to be paid on half-yearly basis on 30th September and 31st March. Interest on the debentures for the year ended 31st March, 2025 will be :

hi.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2024 को डीडी लिमिटेड ने ₹ 50 प्रत्येक के 2,000, 9% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 5% प्रीमियम पर किया, जिनका शोधन पाँच वर्षों के पश्चात ₹ 10 प्रति ऋणपत्र के प्रीमियम पर किया जाएगा । ऋणपत्रों पर ब्याज का भुगतान अर्धवार्षिक आधार पर 30 सितम्बर तथा 31 मार्च को किया जाएगा । 31 मार्च, 2025 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष में ऋणपत्रों पर ब्याज होगा :

questions.answer: B: Nominal value = 2,000 × ₹ 50 = ₹ 1,00,000. Interest for full year = 1,00,000 × 9% = ₹ 9,000.

en.text: Universal Ltd. took over machinery of ₹ 3,30,000, furniture of ₹ 1,60,000 and liabilities of ₹ 80,000 from Amol Ltd. for a purchase consideration of ₹ 4,50,000. The payment to Amol Ltd. was made by issue of 10% Debentures of ₹ 50 each at a discount of 10%. The number of debentures issued to Amol Ltd. was :

questions.answer: D: Issue price per debenture = ₹ 50 - 10% of 50 = ₹ 45. Number of debentures = Purchase consideration / Issue price = 4,50,000 / 45 = 10,000.

en.text: Raha, Naveen and Vandana were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses equally. Naveen retired on 31st March, 2025. The balance in his capital account after making the necessary adjustments on account of reserves and revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities was ₹ 1,27,000. Naveen was paid ₹ 1,50,000 in full settlement of his claim. The value of goodwill of the firm on the date of Naveen's retirement was :

hi.text: राहा, नवीन तथा वंदना एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा लाभ-हानि का विभाजन बराबर-बराबर करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को नवीन सेवानिवृत्त हो गया । संचयों तथा परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन एवं देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण के सम्बन्ध में आवश्यक समायोजन करने के पश्चात उसके पूँजी खाते का शेष ₹ 1,27,000 था । नवीन को उसके दावे के पूर्ण निपटान में ₹ 1,50,000 का भुगतान किया गया । नवीन की सेवानिवृत्ति की तिथि को फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्य था :

questions.answer: C: Naveen's share of hidden goodwill = Amount paid - Adjusted capital = 1,50,000 - 1,27,000 = ₹ 23,000. Since partners share equally (1/3rd share each), total firm goodwill = 23,000 × 3 = ₹ 69,000.

en.text:
Namita, Narendra and Kunwar were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3 : 1 : 1. The firm closes its books on 31st March every year. Kunwar died on 30th September, 2025. His share in the profits of the firm from 1st April, 2025 to 30th September, 2025 was calculated as per the provisions of the partnership deed which amounted to ₹ 15,600. On the date of Kunwar’s death, the Balance Sheet of the firm showed General Reserve of ₹ 40,000 and Profit and Loss Account (Dr.) ₹ 80,000.
Pass necessary journal entries on Kunwar’s death in the books of the firm.

hi.text:
नमिता, नरेन्द्र तथा कुँवर एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 3 : 1 : 1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बाँटते थे । फर्म अपनी पुस्तकें प्रति वर्ष 31 मार्च को बन्द करती है । 30 सितम्बर, 2025 को कुँवर की मृत्यु हो गयी । 1 अप्रैल, 2025 से 30 सितम्बर, 2025 तक फर्म के लाभ में उसके भाग की गणना साझेदारी संलेख के अनुसार की गयी जो ₹ 15,600 था । कुँवर की मृत्यु की तिथि पर फर्म का स्थिति विवरण ₹ 40,000 का सामान्य संचय तथा ₹ 80,000 का लाभ-हानि खाता (डेबिट) दर्शा रहा था ।
कुँवर की मृत्यु पर फर्म की पुस्तकों में आवश्यक रोजनामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।

questions.answer: Kunwar's share of profit = ₹ 15,600 (P&L Suspense A/c Dr. to Kunwar's Capital A/c); General Reserve share = ₹ 40,000 × 1/5 = ₹ 8,000 (General Reserve A/c Dr. to Kunwar's Capital A/c); P&L (Dr.) share = ₹ 80,000 × 1/5 = ₹ 16,000 (Kunwar's Capital A/c Dr. to P&L A/c).

en.text:
Naik, Vinay and Vibhuti were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4 : 2 : 3. On 31st March, 2025, their Balance Sheet was as follows :

**Balance Sheet of Naik, Vinay and Vibhuti as at 31st March, 2025**
| Liabilities | Amount (₹) | Assets | Amount (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capitals : | | Patents | 54,000 |
| Naik 1,20,000 | | Land and Building | 2,07,000 |
| Vinay 1,20,000 | | Stock | 1,08,000 |
| Vibhuti 1,20,000 | 3,60,000 | Debtors | 81,000 |
| General Reserve | 45,000 | Cash at bank | 54,000 |
| Creditors | 99,000 | | |
| | 5,04,000 | | 5,04,000 |

Naik retired from the firm on the above date on the following terms :
(i) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 1,80,000 and the same was to be treated without opening goodwill account.
(ii) Revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities resulted in a loss of ₹ 18,000.
(iii) Amount payable to Naik was transferred to his loan account.
Pass necessary journal entries for general reserve, revaluation of assets and reassessment of liabilities and goodwill on Naik’s retirement.

hi.text:
नायक, विनय तथा विभूति एक फर्म के साझेदार थे तथा 4 : 2 : 3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2025 को उनका स्थिति विवरण निम्न प्रकार था :

**31 मार्च, 2025 को नायक, विनय तथा विभूति का स्थिति विवरण**
| देयताएँ | राशि (₹) | परिसम्पत्तियाँ | राशि (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| पूँजी : | | एकस्व (पेटेन्ट्स) | 54,000 |
| नायक 1,20,000 | | भूमि तथा भवन | 2,07,000 |
| विनय 1,20,000 | | स्टॉक | 1,08,000 |
| विभूति 1,20,000 | 3,60,000 | देनदार | 81,000 |
| सामान्य संचय | 45,000 | बैंक में रोकड़ | 54,000 |
| लेनदार | 99,000 | | |
| | 5,04,000 | | 5,04,000 |

उपर्युक्त तिथि को नायक निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर फर्म से सेवानिवृत्त हो गया :
(i) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,80,000 किया गया और इसका लेखांकन ख्याति खाता खोले बिना किया जाएगा ।
(ii) परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन तथा देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण के परिणामस्वरूप ₹ 18,000 की हानि हुई ।
(iii) नायक को देय राशि उसके ऋण खाते में हस्तांतरित कर दी गई ।
सामान्य संचय, परिसम्पत्तियों के पुनर्मूल्यांकन तथा देयताओं के पुनर्निर्धारण एवं ख्याति के लिए नायक की सेवानिवृत्ति पर आवश्यक रोजनामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।

questions.answer: Naik's share of Goodwill = ₹ 1,80,000 × 4/9 = ₹ 80,000 (Vinay and Vibhuti Dr. in 2:3); General Reserve share = ₹ 45,000 × 4/9 = ₹ 20,000; Revaluation loss share = ₹ 18,000 × 4/9 = ₹ 8,000; Amount transferred to Naik's Loan A/c = ₹ 1,20,000 + ₹ 20,000 + ₹ 80,000 - ₹ 8,000 = ₹ 2,12,000.

en.text:
Kiara Ltd. purchased assets worth ₹ 12,40,000 and took over liabilities of ₹ 3,40,000 of Amrex Ltd. for a purchase consideration of ₹ 11,00,000. Kiara Ltd. paid half the amount by cheque. The balance amount was settled by issuing 9% debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 10%.
Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Kiara Ltd.

hi.text:
कियारा लिमिटेड ने अमरेक्स लिमिटेड से ₹ 12,40,000 मूल्य की परिसम्पत्तियाँ तथा ₹ 3,40,000 की देयताओं का क्रय ₹ 11,00,000 के क्रय प्रतिफल पर किया । कियारा लिमिटेड ने आधी राशि का भुगतान चैक द्वारा किया । शेष राशि का निपटान ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 9% ऋणपत्रों को 10% प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करके किया ।
कियारा लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोजनामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।

questions.answer: Goodwill = ₹ 11,00,000 - (₹ 12,40,000 - ₹ 3,40,000) = ₹ 2,00,000; Cheque payment = ₹ 5,50,000; Number of debentures = ₹ 5,50,000 / 110 = 5,000; 9% Debentures A/c = ₹ 5,00,000; Securities Premium A/c = ₹ 50,000.

On 1st April, 2024, Zara Ltd. issued 8,000, 9% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a discount of 10%. The company had a balance of ₹ 50,000 in the Securities Premium Account on the same date.

hi.text:
1 अप्रैल, 2024 को ज़ारा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 8,000, 9% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% बट्टे पर किया । इसी तिथि को कम्पनी के प्रतिभूति प्रीमियम खाते में ₹ 50,000 का शेष था ।

questions.answer: Bank A/c Dr. ₹ 7,20,000; Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c Dr. ₹ 80,000; To 9% Debentures A/c ₹ 8,00,000. Writing off: Securities Premium A/c Dr. ₹ 50,000; Statement of P&L Dr. ₹ 30,000; To Discount on Issue of Debentures A/c ₹ 80,000.

questions.answer: (i) WCF Dr. ₹ 1,00,000, Revaluation Dr. ₹ 20,000 To Claim ₹ 1,20,000; (ii) WCF Dr. ₹ 1,00,000 To Claim ₹ 80,000 To Partners' Capital (N: ₹ 9,000, S: ₹ 7,000, H: ₹ 4,000); (iii) WCF Dr. ₹ 1,00,000 To Claim ₹ 1,00,000.

en.text:
Jain and Gupta were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3 : 1. On 1st April, 2024, Agarwal was admitted as a new partner for 1/5th share in the profits of the firm with a minimum guaranteed amount of ₹ 75,000. Any deficiency arising out of this account will be borne by Jain and Gupta in the ratio of 1 : 3. During the year ended 31st March, 2025, the firm earned a net profit of ₹ 3,00,000.
